reuse.why: Turns the shared MONTH_WIDE_CATEGORY_CONDITIONS into a parameterised getMonthWideCategoryConditions and threads the flag through the existing getMonthWideCategories/getBudgetData selectors used by every month-wide action.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in one SQL builder; the only repetition is the necessary optional parameter on each action signature.

placement.why: The variation lives in the shared category-selection layer of budget/actions.ts, not in the individual actions.

scope.why: Only the selector, its callers' signatures, the comment and tests change.

maintainability.why: One boolean parameter on the shared condition builder with an updated comment; the other exclusions are untouched and stay shared.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions still go through getMonthWideCategories or getBudgetData.
